contrasts.name: ridge_vs_gradient_mse
contrasts.description: Both use MSE-family fitting, but ridge also adds proximal shrinkage toward the checkpoint. This is not a strict solver-only contrast; it compares the closed-form regularized solve with an unregularized three-step gradient.

contrasts.name: loss_within_gradient
contrasts.description: Same three-step last-layer gradient update; left changes the objective from SmoothL1 to MSE. This isolates the loss.

contrasts.name: combined_solver_and_loss
contrasts.description: This is a combined solver-plus-loss intervention and is not solver-only evidence; do not attribute all differences to the closed-form solver.

note: Q95 is not additively decomposable; per-run Q-ratios and paired delta-log values are reported without pooling queries across runs.
